WISHLISTCHANNEL_DESCRIPTION: Pins the players wishlist to a channel for card drops pings
WISHLISTCHANNEL_EXTRA_INFO: Whenever a card from your wishlist is dropped, Sofi will ping you
CHANNEL_ADDED: {{author}}, {{channel}} has been set as your wishlist channel in slot {{slot}}
CHANNEL_REPLACED: {{author}}, {{channel}} has been set in slot {{slot}}, replacing {{oldChannel}}
CHANNEL_SWAPPED: {{author}}, {{channel}} has been moved to slot {{slot}} and {{oldChannel}} to slot {{previousSlot}}
CHANNEL_REMOVED: {{author}}, {{channel}} has been removed from your wishlist channels
NO_FREE_SLOT: {{author}}, all your wishlist channel slots are in use. Use `{{command}} list` to manage them
INVALID_CHANNEL: {{author}}, please provide a valid text channel of this server
GEM_SLOT_LOCKED: {{author}}, slot 2 is locked. Unlock it for **{{cost}}** 💎 from `{{command}} list`
SLOT_LOCKED: {{author}}, slot {{slot}} needs a higher patron tier. **[Become a patron](https://shop.sofi.gg/patron)**
PATRON_INFO: -# Patron slots: Gold +1 • Platinum +2 • Ruby +3 • Gamma +5 (on top of the gem slot). They stop working when the patron ends.
USAGE_INFO: -# `{{command}}` toggles this channel • `{{command}} [#channel] <slot>` sets a specific slot
NOT_ENOUGH_GEMS: ❌ You don't have enough gems! You need **{{cost}}** gems.
